units.source_text: 高木乐山名人在他们旁边指点我移动连珠棋和活动五目。

en.t: Master Takagi Rakuzan stood beside them and showed me how to move the pieces in renju and active gomoku.

units.source_text: 高木名人对所有的游艺都十分精通，而且很会琢磨新的游戏，使周围的人都感到快活。

en.t: Master Takagi was thoroughly versed in every kind of amusement, and he was very good at devising new games, making everyone around him cheerful.

units.source_text: 今天还听说他设计了一种“闺秀”的游戏。

en.t: Today I also heard that he had designed a game called "Keishu."
